newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 29.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 29.

text.p: Here are the leading headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene said on Tuesday that Lithuania's bid for European Union membership and the privatisation of big state enerprises were two inseparable processes.
- Two-hundred Lithuanian students took part in a model parliament in the parliament on Tuesday.
